title: The Little Red Wagon's Holiday
synopsis: Lisa takes her everyday garden wagon on a small holiday with Grandpa, all the way to the bean patch.

related_resources.reason: AAP guidance invites connections between book events and daily life; it did not test the wagon holiday.
CDC guidance includes story conversations and noticing familiar surroundings, not a validated effect from this manuscript.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: “Today,” she told Grandpa, “the wagon can have a holiday.”
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: An ordinary object becomes a pretend participant while staying in a familiar place.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Parent/caregiver guidance supports only broad age-appropriate editorial practices. It does not assess this original story or prove any cognitive, behavioral or sleep outcome.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Grandpa held the handle with her.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A small obstacle is resolved with adult support, not an injunction to keep trying alone.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Parent/caregiver guidance supports only broad age-appropriate editorial practices. It does not assess this original story or prove any cognitive, behavioral or sleep outcome.

source_note: Original fiction. Parent-facing sources justify only broad shared-reading/play contexts; fictional stars, giants, dragon sneezes, and the narrative outcomes are not findings in cited research. No sleep or developmental gains are claimed.
